title: Yasuní: oil, rainforest and the 2023 vote
goal: Talk about the Yasuní park, its oil and the 2023 vote, granting points with si bien.
grammar: concessive clauses with si bien and the indicative

items: I can grant a point formally with *si bien* + indicative.
I can say what Yasuní is and what Ecuadorians voted on in August 2023.
I can use the new words for the debate: *petróleo*, *pozo*, *biodiversidad*, *consulta*.
